ITEM 1 | Pale golden-orange shredded strands, thin matchstick-like pieces about 4-6 cm long and 1-2 mm thick, bright matte orange with slight sheen, moist and crisp-looking, loosely mounded and spread across the lower-right of the plate, with a few stray shreds scattered beyond the pile | 110
ITEM 2 | Flaked light-beige mixture with visible chunks of pale fish-like flakes, diced pale green celery-like pieces, thin pink-white onion slivers and small orange carrot bits, moist and lightly bound, mounded in a dome about 7 cm across at the upper-right of the plate | 120
ITEM 3 | Whole cherry tomatoes, glossy bright red, smooth skin, about 2-2.5 cm in diameter, six to seven pieces intact, clustered on the left side of the plate beside the carrots, firm and juicy-looking with slight sheen | 75
ITEM 4 | Dark brown-maroon olives, glossy and smooth-skinned, about 1.5-2 cm long, roughly eight pieces in a loose cluster at the lower-left, beneath the tomatoes and beside the carrot pile, with a slight oily sheen | 40
ITEM 5 | Two grayish-green fish pieces with mottled skin and darker dorsal patches, roughly 4-5 cm long and 2-3 cm thick, soft-looking and moist, placed at the upper-left edge of the plate on top of a creamy white sauce | 60
ITEM 6 | Creamy white sauce, opaque and smooth with slight glossy sheen, thick dollop about 6 cm across with soft, slightly ruffled edges, spread beneath and around the fish pieces at the upper-left of the plate | 35
